contributions.detail: p2 Form A is entirely blank (no filer ink; the faint marks are bleed-through from the reverse side, verified at 200 dpi). Cover line 1 reads 0 in ALL THREE columns (LAST, THIS, CUMULATIVE), so the empty schedule closes against every printed anchor and the two scopes coincide. The Carr form prints NO schedule total on Form A — schedule_total is null because the field does not exist on this form.

expenditures.detail: one row, 618.00, equals cover line 3 CUMULATIVE 618.00. It does NOT equal the THIS REPORT cell (0), so the row set is on the CUMULATIVE scope — the single 3-17-2014 filing-fee expenditure was reported on the prior interim report and is carried forward in the cumulative column, while this summary report adds nothing new. Form B prints no schedule total; the cover line is the only anchor.

gates.page_subtotal: Neither Carr schedule prints a page subtotal or a schedule total — the form has no such field on p2 or p3 (the footer reads only '(If additional space is needed, use blank paper and list information like the above format and file with this report)'). Cover lines 1 and 3 are the sole anchors and both close exactly.

gates.balance_chain: DOES NOT CLOSE — filer arithmetic. Cover line 4 balance-at-end CUMULATIVE reads 618.00, but contributions cumulative 0 (line 1) + 0 (line 2) minus expenses cumulative 618.00 = -618.00. No earlier filing by this filer is in this chunk, so the cross-filing cumulative chain was not runnable here.
